items.purpose: 三屏 APP 视觉方向概念图
items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-quality visual direction board for a real Chinese focus timer app; concept reference only, never represent as code capture.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact original 小芽 mascot identity reference: low rounded milk-white ceramic pot, two thick forest-green leaves, tiny black dot eyes, small smile. Images 2–4 are the actual existing v1.1 today, focus, and history screens; preserve their Chinese editorial typography family, product identity, content hierarchy, and screen-specific tasks while refining the visual surface.
Primary request: Create one precise wide landscape board with three equal, parallel, straight-on, borderless tall app-screen compositions arranged side by side, no phone perspective, no phone hardware. This is an opt-in tech-refined light-theme mapping: increase precision and subtle depth without changing the QIKE brand or turning the work screens into a flashy dashboard.
Screen 1 — Today: exact headline "给专注，留一点空间。"; show the same 小芽 mascot; visibly present three duration choices "15 分钟", "25 分钟", "45 分钟"; one clear primary action "开始专注"; a concise task section using existing familiar task-row style.
Screen 2 — Focus: exact headline "此刻，只做一件在意的事。"; clear ready state "准备专注"; exact timer "25:00"; primary "开始计时" and secondary "结束" controls. Keep this a useful pre-start screen, no new functionality.
Screen 3 — History: exact headline "小小的专注，也在生长。"; show "185 分钟" with a nearby explicit "示例数据" indicator; a simple, readable seven-day bar chart and a short focus-record list.
Design language: a carefully aligned grid, polished Chinese editorial typography matching the supplied screen references, crisp baseline rhythm, fine thin edges, stable paper-white planes, forest-green semantic actions, a precise timer numeral, a very restrained green light field and one or two subtle translucent treatment cues only on selected duration controls. Work surfaces remain calm, legible, familiar, and task-first.
Palette: paper white #F7F6EF, forest green #214D3B, deep ink #1E3028, pale sage #E7EDE2; retain established typography and the exact 小芽 identity. Accent light can be a very faint pale green, never purple or dark mode.
Composition: 16:9 landscape, three balanced screen layouts of equal visual scale and aligned heights with ample gutters and whitespace. Keep all screen content comfortably legible and unclipped.
Lighting/material: soft clean daylight, subtle layered paper and ceramic feel, restrained precise highlights.
Constraints: preserve original brand, mascot, text hierarchy, Chinese font character, and three screen tasks. Use only specified realistic app controls/content; chart values should be clearly exemplary, no extra metrics.
Avoid: dark theme, purple, changing typeface, changing mascot, new business functionality, AI/backend activity, fake notifications, random particles, fabricated metrics, dense tiny cards, glass over text or controls, dramatic data visualizations, logos/watermarks, fake device chrome, unreadable pseudo-Chinese.

items.purpose: 宣传页 hero KV，无字无 UI
items.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide 16:9 hero key visual for the 栖刻 QIKE quiet focus timer app landing page.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact 小芽 mascot identity reference to preserve: low, rounded milk-white ceramic pot, two thick forest-green leaves, tiny black dot eyes and subtle smile.
Primary request: A refined, premium 3D product-art hero visual about gentle focus, growth and the passage of time. One small ceramic sprout mascot is the sole hero object, placed center-right, full silhouette visible.
Scene/backdrop: spacious paper-white #F7F6EF environment with a soft warm pale-sage #E7EDE2 atmosphere; visually clean, lightly dimensional, natural and credible. Leave generous calm negative space to the left for separate HTML headline and CTA.
Style/medium: polished 3D matte ceramic product illustration with tactile surface and accurate soft contact shadow. Subtle refined tech-refined light treatment: faint green light halo, one or two soft translucent thin planes and delicate refractive edges behind or around the mascot, restrained and physically plausible.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9 campaign hero art, mascot center-right; open uncluttered left half; balanced whitespace and gentle depth, no cropping of leaves or pot.
Lighting/mood: soft natural studio daylight, quiet focus, warm restrained optimism, no hard neon.
Color palette: paper white #F7F6EF, forest green #214D3B, deep ink #1E3028, pale sage #E7EDE2, very restrained warm highlight. Preserve the established light brand mapping.
Materials/textures: matte milk-white ceramic pot, thick softly textured green leaves, faint translucent glass-like sheet edges only in the background.
Constraints: preserve the referenced mascot identity and original app brand colors; use actual soft shadows; keep every effect behind and away from the future copy area; no alteration to the mascot's face or shape.
Avoid: any text or letters, logo, interface, smartphone, controls, mockup device, numbers, fabricated metrics, chart, random particles, purple, dark background, heavy glassmorphism, luminous neon, extra characters, watermark.
